responsibility: Implements Rust HIR type-node resolution into the internal TyTy representation. It resolves tuple, function-pointer, path, qualified-path, array, slice, reference, raw-pointer, inferred, never, and trait-object types; applies path-segment probing and generic substitutions; resolves generic parameters and where-clause bounds into ParamType and TypeBoundPredicate structures; and stores the resulting types in the typecheck context for reuse by items and expressions.
same_name_distinction: Implements conversion of HIR type syntax into TyTy nodes, including path and qualified-path resolution, array-size expression checking, generic-parameter resolution, and where-clause bound application. Unlike rust-hir-type-check-type.h, it contains the executable type-resolution and bound-processing logic.
